comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Sold in the San Francisco Item Shop if you have the Adept of Ages (19th Century) Chrono title equipped, or an item with Age effect (19th century) EX Effect equipped.

Speaking of which, it can be upgraded with Transmutation Alchemy to Shirt and Denim Pants EX -- see page for details.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Skill/Product/Alchemy/ItemBoost

wiki: Appears in San Francisco's Item Shop with Adept of Ages (19th Century) title or Age effect (19th century) equipment -- sells for 20,000 ducats.
